text:
The most common yellow fruit that monkeys also eat is the banana.

Analysis of the sentence "The most common yellow fruit that monkeys also eat is the banana":

- **The**: Definite article (Determiner)
- **most common**: Superlative adjective phrase (Adjective)
- **yellow**: Adjective
- **fruit**: Noun (Subject)
- **that**: Relative pronoun (Conjunction/Pronoun)
- **monkeys**: Noun (Subject of relative clause)
- **also**: Adverb
- **eat**: Verb (Predicate of relative clause)
- **is**: Verb (Linking verb)
- **the**: Definite article (Determiner)
- **banana**: Noun (Subject complement)
